items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Willie Lynch was the leader, but they called him...his name was automatically changed to Earl Jackson, to keep the royal names up -- Count Basie, Duke Ellington, Earl Jackson.

ctx.x: Willie Lynch got the band together for Irving Mills -- and they called it the Blue Rhythm Band, Irving Mills' Blue Rhythm Band. And Willie Lynch was the leader, but they called him...his name was automatically changed to Earl Jackson, to keep the royal names up -- Count Basie, Duke Ellington, Earl Jackson. They were all royal names. Earl Hines and so forth, you know?
